rows.question: Which valves must be closed to isolate T4750 for maintenance? List them in the order you would close them, explain the order, and say which connections this drawing does not let you isolate.

required.item: the line from SV 104.01 has no isolation valve

rows.answer:
Derived by graph analysis of the drawing
- GlobeValve 47123/C1 (GlobeValve-2) is the nearest valve on the upstream side of T4750 (Tank-1) (line 47123, DN 80) [E3.2, isolation_boundary]
- GlobeValve 47127/C1 (GlobeValve-1) is the nearest valve on the upstream side of T4750 (Tank-1) (line 47127, DN 50) [E3.3, isolation_boundary]
- ButterflyValve 47124/C1 (ButterflyValve-1) is the nearest valve on the downstream side of T4750 (Tank-1) (line 47124, DN 80) [E3.4, isolation_boundary]
